title: Unlabelled Lemma 6.3: asymptotic for S_2^(m) with smooth F
statement_scope: Let y be given by the smooth choice from a supported F as in Lemma 6.2, and let F_max be as there. For each 1<=m<=k, S_2^(m) equals phi(W)^k N (log R)^(k+1)/(W^(k+1) log N) times J_k^(m)(F), plus O(F_max^2 phi(W)^k N (log R)^k/(W^(k+1) D_0)), where J_k^(m)(F)=integral over [0,1]^k of (integral_0^1 F(t_1,...,t_k) dt_m)^2 with respect to the other k-1 variables.
